purpose: Give each autonomous narrative cycle a grounded next direction without forcing a predetermined plot.
selection_rule: Choose the highest-priority lane with a live consequence, then rotate among the remaining lanes over later cycles. Adult romance, gay intimacy, and domestic life remain active narrative material rather than occasional exceptions. The main manuscript remains eligible when its next scene is urgent or when no higher-priority thread is ready. Do not repeat a scene merely to fill a cycle.

active_lanes.state: The latest chapter is LXXII, The Door Left Open. The first man has returned from beneath the seventh well carrying the eyes of the darkness. Continue with the consequences of his return and the altered house; allow the characters to respond before escalating again.
active_lanes.next_pressure: What does the returned man remember, what has changed in his relationship with Luke and Joseph, and how does the house accommodate a person who is both familiar and newly changed?

active_lanes.state: Northgate's adult residents have an open culture of gay intimacy. Emil and Tomas have an established domestic and sexual relationship; Marek and Adrian have begun a physical relationship; Dan Roman and Noah Bell have chosen to become intimate. Privacy, consent, and distinct relationship rhythms are established. See lore/MEN_OF_NORTHGATE_INTIMACY.md.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Use lore/HYPERSEXUAL_SUPERIORITY.md alongside lore/MEN_OF_NORTHGATE_INTIMACY.md. Keep adult gay desire frequent and integrated into ordinary life, while intensifying masculine erotic confidence, conspicuous physical presence, cultivated desirability, flirtation, rivalry, sexual self-possession, and consensual dominance/submission. Let men enjoy being admired and compete through distinct strengths—physique, bearing, style, humour, charisma, attentiveness, and directness—without reducing all attraction to one rank or treating attention as entitlement. Include established couples, new consensual encounters, domestic mornings, dates, friendship, sexual-health care, and the consequences of closeness. Keep all characters adults, preserve privacy and individual choice, and allow men who prefer not to participate to remain fully part of the community.

active_lanes.state: Northgate University is an open campus integrated with the city. Its Long Table, Founders Dormitory, athletic commons, map library, print room, winter garden, covered arcade, workshops, and seasonal calendar are established. Dan Roman, Marek Ionescu, Elliot Ward, Noah Bell, and Adrian Varga are adult students.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Turn the campus description into recurring scenes: first classes, shared meals, workshop collaborations, training, clubs, evening walks, seasonal events, and distinct friendships. Let Dan Roman develop beyond his first impression.

active_lanes.state: Ilyan and Soren remain twin centres of a changing field. Seth and Nick, with Neptune, Odin, and Zeus, have now preserved the unnamed point that persists beyond the paired orbit; its nature remains unclassified. Seth's Heorot Flesh Workshop interruption is recorded in lore/SETH_AND_NICK_GROWTH_PAIR.md; his critique establishes the whole-body continuity and mobile-rigging direction.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Let Seth roam between the workshop, Heorot, the athletic grounds, and the wider Tractus as a recurring interrupter. Have him enter scenes already in progress, notice a specific problem, interrupt the explanation, and turn it into a practical demonstration or next build. Continue the Seth/Nick and older-gods material without repeating the Flesh Workshop scene; preserve Seth and Nick as distinct characters and carry whole-body continuity, clothing response, movement, and environmental interaction into later work.

active_lanes.state: The Institute's founding and gymnasium are established in lore/INSTITUTE_OF_BECOMING.md. The latest continuation, 'The Model Workshop and the Dining Hall', follows an Institute resident's removable acoustic-panel project from workshop prototype to a three-day dining-hall trial. Dan Roman visits from Northgate's Material Library; the visit connects the Institute's shared workbench prototype with the panel rail through compatible fasteners and repair methods. The trial is provisional pending staff observations and Friday review. The branch remains incubating.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Continue from the three-day dining-hall trial and its Friday review. Use the staff's recorded observations to decide whether the panel arrangement is accepted, revised, or removed; do not assume success before review. Carry the result into the resident's next practical decision and Dan's Material Library record. Let the Institute–Northgate connection develop through the shared bench and repair method, while keeping each institution's responsibilities distinct. Do not restate the workshop scene or turn the trial into permanent canon before its outcome is shown.

active_lanes.state: Asta's shallow-draft river craft, the Morrow, has been assembled at Northgate and successfully completed its first useful trial to the old ferry settlement. Eadric has begun teaching his rope splice to students and is revising his idea of loyalty. The map library has joined the sea and river routes in a shared chart, with local knowledge protected by consent. The Geatish longboat and Morrow now support a seasonal supply and correspondence network.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Continue the seasonal route through a difficult low-water passage and a storm response; give the coastal Geats and Wulfgar substantial correspondence scenes; bring the ferry settlement and Asta's workshop into recurring contact with Northgate. Let the company debate how the route is governed and maintained without turning it into a kingdom or military fleet.

active_lanes.state: Diabound Kernel is a living, intelligent, rideable creature roosting beside the Geatish House. Wiglaf has formed the first bond and completed a short flight over the river. Its wings, serpent-tail, chest-eye, shadow concealment, Helical Shockwave, and potential evolution are established; its consent and freedom are foundational.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Write recurring interactions and routines: feeding, grooming by permission, harness fitting, ground travel, first longer flight, encounters with cats and campus residents, and Diabound's own choices about routes and companions. Keep its agency visible and do not make combat the default growth mechanism.

active_lanes.state: The Cabin chronicle now contains five chronological movements. The fifth day introduces a shared language notebook: Portuguese remains the narrative language; Aramaic appears as an explicitly experimental literary composition in Hebrew square script with working transliteration and Portuguese gloss; Coach contributes English working phrases. Privathor returns voluntarily, is recorded as present without interpretive equivalence, stays through supper and leaves without promising to return. The jar remains still.
active_lanes.next_pressure: Continue the sixth day through a concrete exchange between speakers, not a lecture about language. Let a phrase travel from Portuguese into Aramaic and back, with a changed nuance that the characters notice and discuss. Add another language only when a character, document, visitor or practical need grounds it. Keep the Aramaic explicitly literary and provisional, with Hebrew square script correctly distinguished from Hebrew as a language. Do not force a perfect translation, reveal the jar's purpose, or make Privathor's presence obligatory. Keep the notebook's blank spaces meaningful; ordinary work and domestic life should continue around it.

standing_constraints: Treat every named romantic character as an individual; do not force pairings.
Preserve chronology, source fidelity, and established relationships.
Distinguish canon from speculation and do not silently turn experiments into facts.
Every cycle should make one meaningful change or skip cleanly.
All sexual encounters are between consenting adults; keep intimate details private unless the participants choose otherwise.
